rule: Prose in source_of_truth wins. This file encodes tokens that those documents already name. It does not add bands, refusal reasons, surfaces, grades, or geographies.

tokens.may_hold: Spine key, grain, jurisdiction, geometry handle, native keys, and identity refusals.
Designation, zoning, property class, or other published land classification, each labelled as which vocabulary it is.
tokens.must_not_hold: A NAICS code pretending to be a by-law, or a by-law pretending to be a New York property class.

tokens.may_hold: Overlays and encumbrances a joined source states (flood, heritage, environmental, easement, and similar), each named by authority.
tokens.must_not_hold: A sum of unrelated overlays into one constraint score, or a missing overlay shown as clear.

tokens.may_hold: Registers of activity placed on this key: employment inventory, permits, licences, facility registrations.
tokens.must_not_hold: An inference that a business is operating, closed, or failing.

tokens.may_hold: Named readings computed from earlier rungs, each with inputs and method.
tokens.must_not_hold: Raw source fields copied forward, or a composite of every reading.

tokens.may_hold: The packet a reader can take away: the same claims and the same refusals, on the share and export surfaces.
tokens.must_not_hold: A postcard that drops refusals to look complete.

notes: Order is fixed. A later band may use an earlier one. It may not be shown as the same kind of fact.
The MCS header stays dossier_bands. dossier is a ui_surfaces token, not a band.
Do not invent regulatory, physical, neighbours, or dossier as band names.
A rung is empty only as a refusal. Empty never means vacant, idle, unconstrained, or unlicensed-as-a-fact-about-the-business.

tokens.meaning: At least one claim that passes the Claim & Refusal Contract.
No claim on the rung. Exactly one refusal reason.

notes: These are rung statuses, not evidence grades and not assertion states.
A rung can be filled and still carry a separate refusal for something that rung does not have.
There is no third, silent status.

tokens.role: The minimum: outline or point, key, jurisdiction, refusals. What a map selection must be able to say before any dossier opens.
The banded reading of one unit, from the current partial presentation up to the maximum. One surface among others.
A human-readable packet of the same claims and refusals.
A machine-readable packet of the same claims and refusals.

notes: Surfaces are protocol roles, not screens.
share and export are the share_export rung made concrete. They are not a cleaner subset.
The word dossier does not appear in dossier_bands as a band token.

tokens.use_when: The layer, jurisdiction, or vintage is outside what v1 holds, or the responsible publisher does not release that object. Geography outside the v1 list is this reason. A city with no public parcel fabric is this reason for parcel grain.
A source exists and HeavyMap is not allowed to use it. Ontario assessment via MPAC is the standing example.
A usable source is in hand, or is expected in the joined set, and this key has no accepted join yet.

precedence: If a layer is both unlicensed and unjoined, not_licensed wins: there is nothing to join.
If a layer was never in the v1 set, not_in_coverage wins: do not imply a join is the remaining step.
notes: One reason only.
Not joined is not vacant. Not licensed is not unassessed. Not in coverage is not no industrial activity.
There is no fourth refusal code for owner name. Owner name is not a v1 ladder object.

tokens.meaning: Copied from a source and normalised. Not interpreted.
An observed value placed on this spine key by a named join method. The method is part of the stamp.
Computed from named inputs by a named method. A reading, not a new observation.
No assertion. A refusal reason is required. There is no grade that means probably empty.

notes: joined is not more true than observed. It records an extra step that can be wrong.
Evidence grade refused is not band status refused, and it is not an assertion state.
Dataset disposition derive is not evidence grade derived.

tokens.reader_takeaway: Address text matched after normalisation. Some rows of that table will have failed.
A point of this unit fell inside a published polygon.
Geometry of this unit sits inside the source geometry.
Nearest feature under a stated distance. The distance is not access.
Area overlap above a stated threshold.

notes: Names follow the prior-art set. The claims sketch does not re-specify tolerances.

assertion_states.applies_when: An assertion is filled. A refusal is not one of these states.

tokens.meaning: Two stamped records disagree. Both stay, grades and stamps intact.
A later check knocks down an assertion. The assertion and the refutation both remain visible.

notes: The contract names supported, contested, and refuted. It defines contested and refuted in prose. It does not give supported a separate procedure.
Deleting a contested line would hide the disagreement.
Most units will have no assertion beyond their observed attributes. That is a normal filled ladder, not a thin one.

spine_key.regex_note: Mechanical reading of the parts table for v1. Country is ca or us. Region is on or ny. Jurisdiction is a lowercase slug (hyphens allowed). Grain is parcel, footprint, or address. Local is the remainder, may include digits, hyphens, and dots, and must not contain a colon. Synthetic examples use a SYN- prefix; the prefix is not required for every key.

jurisdiction.note: Stable slug of the publishing government the grain comes from. For a Niagara Region lower-tier municipality the slug is the lower tier (for example welland), not niagara. This vocab does not list every slug.

meanings.parcel: A publisher in v1 releases a parcel polygon HeavyMap is licensed to use, and the polygon is the thing the reader would point at.
meanings.footprint: Building outline is the best licensed geometry. There is no joined parcel polygon.
meanings.address: Only a point or a normalized address is licensed and joined.

local.note: Unique inside that jurisdiction and grain. Synthetic examples use a SYN- prefix. Dots are allowed so the Erie SBL illustration matches.

examples.note: Illustration of a lower-tier city whose open data, in prior art, had no parcel fabric. Not an observation of real land.
Illustration of a v1 county where a public tax-parcel polygon is the pattern. The municipality slug stays erie until a SWIS join names a city or town. Not an observation of real land.

notes: The key is HeavyMap's. Publishers keep their own keys in native_keys.
A native key is never silently promoted to the spine key.
A spine key may be minted only inside geography v1. Outside the fence there is no key.
Inside the fence, missing data is still a key plus a refusal.

dataset_dispositions.name: D-5
dataset_dispositions.note: Disposition of a dataset. Not a ladder band and not an evidence grade. derive here is not evidence grade derived.

notes: Names are copied from the architecture index. They are not spine-key slugs.
Niagara Region's twelve lower-tier municipalities are St. Catharines through West Lincoln in the canada list.
Norfolk County includes Port Dover. Port Dover is not a separate v1 jurisdiction name.
A spine key for a Niagara lower-tier municipality uses the lower-tier slug, not niagara.
Hamilton, Haldimand, and Norfolk are single-tier. Brantford and Brant County are distinct.
Halton and Burlington are out of core for v1.

register_quotation_only.rule: These words may appear only as a quotation of a register, with evidence grade observed or joined and a stamp. Without that quotation they are forbidden, including as summaries of a refusal.

fields.note: If the refusal is not_licensed, the stamp names the product that was not used.

fields.required: Yes when the source has one.

fields.note: The date the file was obtained.
The date the source's fact refers to. A by-law adopted in one year and retrieved in another keeps both dates.
Layer index, unit of measure, address restyling, and similar traps.

notes: The original published value survives next to any normalised one.
retrieved_on and observation_on both show when both exist. The presentation does not collapse them into updated.

columns.dossier_bands: Ladder band tokens this dataset may fill, in ladder order, |-separated. Defined in context-band-ladder.md.
columns.ui_surfaces: PCDP surface tokens allowed to show the dataset: selection, dossier, share, export. Defined in PCDP.md.
columns.derived_readings: Reading identifiers this dataset may feed. Empty means the dataset feeds no reading. Not the ladder token derived_readings. Defined in claim-refusal-contract.md.

derived_reading_identifiers.method_kind: Convert published floor area to square metres; keep the source unit on the stamp.
derived_reading_identifiers.typical_refusal: not_in_coverage when no floor area was published.

derived_reading_identifiers.method_kind: Carry a published employment band as a range.
derived_reading_identifiers.typical_refusal: not_in_coverage where no employment register exists.

derived_reading_identifiers.method_kind: Building footprint area divided by parcel area.
derived_reading_identifiers.typical_refusal: not_in_coverage or not_licensed when parcel area is missing; never 0.

illustrative.note: Examples from claim-refusal-contract.md. A new identifier may be added when a reading is specified. This list is not a closed catalog, and these identifiers are not ladder tokens.
